criteria.title: Implement bounded counting semaphores with nonblocking try, blocking wait and ISR-safe post. Specify maximum count and choose an error on overflow rather than silently discarding a counted event.

passages: 3.2 The Synchronizing Primitives: indivisible P/V definitions
4.3 The Bounded Buffer: empty/full credits and buffer exclusion

criteria.task: Implement try/timed wait and bounded post over the shared wait protocol. Make count=maximum and UINT_MAX boundary operations return the declared overflow result without mutation. Add a separate interrupt-entry wrapper that may wake but never block; show its deferred scheduling request and saved-mask restoration.
